summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), added the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias, added the numpy and torch.nn.functional imports, exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty class cases. The constructor validates squareness, max-normalizes the matrix, and stores m and num_classes. forward returns the batch mean and uses cross-sample TP and D helpers. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so the tests are unverified; the spec's worked examples were checked by reading. No commits were made. The only line over 120 columns is pre-existing, in DiceLoss's docstring.
